explication: FL Chart is a Flutter charting library. A developer configures a chart through its public API and supplies chart data; the library then renders the selected chart as a Flutter widget. The README documents six chart types and animation support. The tree shows shared chart foundations and utility layers, but the sampled source does not include their runtime call paths, so those internal relationships are shown as unverified dashed links.
